def solution():
    home_price = 500_000
    first_principal = home_price * 0.80
    second_principal = home_price * 0.10

    first_rate = 0.035 / 12
    first_payments = 30 * 12
    first_monthly_payment = (
        first_principal * first_rate
        / (1 - (1 + first_rate) ** -first_payments)
    )

    second_rate = 0.06 / 12
    second_payments = 15 * 12
    second_monthly_payment = (
        second_principal * second_rate
        / (1 - (1 + second_rate) ** -second_payments)
    )

    answer = round(first_monthly_payment + second_monthly_payment)
    return answer
